items.title: A new deck, 326 cards
items.detail: Every card rewritten, from light warm-ups to questions that go deeper as the night goes on. Cards you played before wait until the rest have had a turn.

items.title: Four new ways to play
items.detail: Same brain: say it together and match the group. On a scale: give a clue for your secret number. Hot potato: pass the phone before it goes off. Secret missions: pull one off without getting caught.

items.title: Rosin, edibles and smarter spins
items.detail: Log rosin and edibles, with edibles counted in pieces and milligrams. The roulette only suggests what fits: no pure hash joints, and a pure joint only when there's enough flower left.

items.title: A better flow
items.detail: No kind of card twice in a row, everyone gets paired up in turn, a countdown for answering together and the standings every 15 cards.

items.title: Party games, rebuilt
items.detail: A deck of 157 cards in English and Dutch: challenges, duels, votes, questions, charades, debates and table rules, with your names on them. Play full screen, card after card.

items.title: Roulette with toggles
items.detail: Spin for a strain, a way to smoke, a game or any mix. Switch off what you don't want.

items.title: A calmer, clearer look
items.detail: Opaque cards on a quiet page, a true black dark mode, numbers that stand out and layouts that hold up at every text size.

items.title: Fixes
items.detail: A crash while logging a session is fixed, sheets no longer show the page through them, and Dutch text no longer gets squeezed.

items.title: New games, dealt fresh
items.detail: Never have I ever, Would you rather, Hot seat, Absurd debate, Conspiracy corner, charades and more. Each round deals new questions, scenes or topics, in English and Dutch.

items.title: Pick a game yourself
items.detail: Every game is in a library under the spin. Start one, deal new prompts, pass the turn and keep score.

items.title: Table rules
items.detail: A rule for the whole table, like talking like a pirate, that lasts five spins.

items.title: Bigger legendary pulls
items.detail: A proper reveal, new cards like Plot twist and Chef's choice, and a guaranteed legendary after 20 spins without one.

items.title: Taima in Dutch
items.detail: Set your iPhone to Dutch and Taima speaks it too, from the labels to the widgets.

items.title: Repeat last session
items.detail: Log the same amount and method again in one tap, from Stash, a bag or the widget.

items.title: Log from the Home Screen
items.detail: The bag-in-use widget comes in a medium size with all quick amounts.

items.title: A calendar of your use
items.detail: Stats shows each month at a glance: days with use, shaded by amount, and days without.

items.title: On this day
items.detail: See what you collected around this date in earlier years.

items.title: Roulette and games
items.detail: Spin for a strain, a way to smoke and a game like Bim Bam Baap. Add players, keep score, chase rare legendary pulls and make every rule your own, in Tools.

items.title: Strain sources
items.detail: Every curated lineage now shows where it comes from. Growers and sources update with the strain library.

items.title: Cleaner label photos
items.detail: Taima straightens and crops the bag in your photo, evens out the light and reads both versions.

items.title: Better label reading
items.detail: More label layouts, dates and weights are understood, and every filled-in value can be checked.

items.title: Improve older entries
items.detail: Re-read the bags you already have and accept what the better reader adds. Nothing you typed is changed.

items.title: A bigger strain library
items.detail: Many more curated strains, aliases and crosses, and the library now updates itself.

items.title: Timed notes
items.detail: Write how a session is going, with an optional photo, from the bag, the Stash or the Live Activity.

items.title: Learns your fixes
items.detail: When you correct a name Taima misread, it remembers on this iPhone. You can choose to share samples to help everyone.

items.title: Updates and reminders
items.detail: Add Taima's source to SideStore for automatic updates. Taima tells you about new versions and reminds you the day before a refresh is due.

items.title: Clearer milestones
items.detail: Tap a badge in Stats to see what earns it, where to do it and how far along you are.

items.title: Countdown to 4/20
items.detail: Tools now counts the days to 20 April, next to the daily 4:20.

items.title: Undo and polish
items.detail: Take back a stock change, a removed session or a deleted note. Taima asks before discarding edits, and layout, contrast and wording are clearer throughout.

items.title: Rotate to scan
items.detail: For prerolls and jars: turn the label slowly in front of the camera. Taima reads every side, combines what it sees and keeps the clearest frame as the photo. Find it in the + menu, or under photos in the editor.

items.title: Tighter privacy
items.detail: The Face ID lock now covers everything, Siri needs an unlocked iPhone, and discreet mode keeps names off the Lock Screen, widgets and Spotlight.

items.title: Encrypted and automatic backups
items.detail: Backups are protected with a passphrase and handle big collections. Turn on daily backups to a folder you choose.

items.title: Edible wait timer
items.detail: Log an edible and the Lock Screen shows how long ago you took it, so you wait before taking more.

items.title: Safer use and a self-check
items.detail: Trimbos tips, Dutch help lines and an optional private check-in, all in Tools.

items.title: Use-free days and break savings
items.detail: See use-free days each week, and the grams and euros a break keeps in your pocket.

items.title: Tobacco and patterns
items.detail: Note tobacco per session; Stats shows mood by time of day and THC.

items.title: Would buy again
items.detail: Mark bags you'd buy again; the shop scanner reminds you.

items.title: Year in review
items.detail: Share your year in Taima as a card.

items.title: Calmer and faster
items.detail: Settings on every tab, one search, clearer cards, better contrast and much faster Stats.

items.title: Start over
items.detail: Settings can delete all of Taima's data on this iPhone and start fresh. You can export a backup first, and you confirm by typing DELETE.

items.title: Camera fixed
items.detail: Taking a photo no longer closes the camera straight away, and a new label photo is read at once.

items.title: Strain library
items.detail: Search over 9,000 strains in the Search tab, with lineage, aliases, crosses and a family tree. Tap the heart to keep a want-to-try list.

items.title: Scores, effects and flavours
items.detail: Rate out of 10 in half stars and note effects, downsides and flavours. Stats turns them into insights.

items.title: Sessions
items.detail: Log how you used and how you felt before and after, and see when and how you use most.

items.title: Do I have this?
items.detail: Point the camera at a bag in the shop to see if you already have it, or how you rated it.

items.title: Weekly limit and reminders
items.detail: Set a weekly limit and get a reminder when your stash runs low.

items.title: Shops and spending
items.detail: Note where you bought a bag and see spending and price per gram by shop.

items.title: Privacy
items.detail: Lock Taima with Face ID, or switch on discreet mode for a plain icon and no names on widgets.

items.title: Share, compare and milestones
items.detail: Share a review card, compare two bags and collect milestones. All ten growers and hash are in.

items.title: Your own photos
items.detail: Replace any photo, add pictures of the flower itself and pick which one shows in your collection.

items.title: Bag in use, everywhere
items.detail: The bag you're using sits above the tab bar with a quick log button. Settings moved to the gear in Collection, and Search has its own tab.

items.title: Cleaner stats
items.detail: Bars no longer overlap their labels, sizes compare by grams, and growers get their own colours.

items.title: Growers filled in
items.detail: Bags saved earlier get their grower from the label text Taima already read.

items.title: Stash and inventory
items.detail: Mark bags as full, open or empty, log what you use and see how long your stash lasts.

items.title: Live Activity
items.detail: The bag in use sits on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, with buttons to log an amount.

items.title: Widgets and controls
items.detail: Stash and bag-in-use widgets, a Control Center button to scan, and Siri shortcuts.

items.title: Prerolls and jars
items.detail: Track preroll packs one at a time and keep jars next to your bags.

items.title: Back of the bag
items.detail: Add a photo of the back. Taima recognizes growers such as Aardachtig, FYTA, Holigram and Canadelaar (COG) and fills in what the front missed.

items.title: Strains together
items.detail: See every bag of the same strain combined, with its THC over time.

items.title: Livelier stats
items.detail: Pick a time range and tap or drag the charts for details.

items.title: Tools
items.detail: Joint and edible calculators, a tolerance break counter, strain roulette and countdowns to 4:20 and 4/20.

items.title: Meet the mascot
items.detail: Taima has a new icon: a friendly little leaf.
